snippet.title: The Funnel | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Try the demo now at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180550/The_Funnel__Demo/

The Funnel's demo covers the first narrative act and first central minigame of The Funnel. Meet your crew mates, build gear boxes, and delve into the beginning of The Funnel's mysteries as this underground steampunk world begins to crack.

Learn more at: https://bronzemanstudio.com/funnel
